title: BLOCK DISPLAY DELETER (BDD)
description: Adds Command that deletes Block Display
body:
**BlockDisplayDeleter**  
*Remove unwanted BlockDisplay entities with a single command.*

---

### 📦 What it does  
BlockDisplayDeleter gives you a quick way to clear all **BlockDisplay** entities that are floating around your world.  
Just stand where you want to clean up, type the command, and all BlockDisplays within the radius you specify will vanish.

---

### ⚙️ How to use  

```
/bd delete <distance>
```

* `<distance>` – the radius (in blocks) around you in which BlockDisplays will be removed.  
* Example: `/bd delete 10` will delete every BlockDisplay within 10 blocks of you.

**Permissions**  
Only players with the permission node `bd.delete` can run the command.  
Give it to a group or a single player with your permission plugin of choice.

---

### 🛠️ Installation  

1. Download the latest **BlockDisplayDeleter.jar** from the Modrinth page.  
2. Drop it into your server’s `plugins/` folder.  
3. Restart or reload the server.  
4. The console will show:  
   ```
   BlockDisplayRemover włączony!
   ```

---

### 📜 Features  

| Feature | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Fast removal** | Instantly deletes all BlockDisplays in the specified radius. |
| **Safe** | Only affects BlockDisplay entities – nothing else is touched. |
| **Localized** | Messages are in Polish (you can change the text in the source if you prefer another language). |
| **Permission‑based** | Control who can use the command. |


### 📬 Support  

Found a bug or have a feature request?  
Open an issue on the Modrinth page or contact the author via the plugin’s Discord/Forum link.

---

Enjoy a cleaner world with **BlockDisplayDeleter**!
